Bruk-Bet Termalica Nieciecza Klub Sportowy Spółka Akcyjna, commonly referred to as Bruk-Bet Termalica Nieciecza, is a Polish professional football club based in Nieciecza. The team competes in the I liga, the second tier of the Polish football league system, following their 2025–26 Ekstraklasa relegation.
